scripts.build:android: expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon --console=plain -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a
scripts.build:ios: expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/AudioAnalyzerExpo.xcworkspace -scheme AudioAnalyzerExpo -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
